settings.enabled_help: Check registrations, topics, replies, posts, and profile changes against Forum Fortress.
settings.api_region_help: Lock check traffic to a region, or use the recommended global network.
settings.allow_global_fallback_help: After a regional retry fails, permit the global network. Processing may occur outside the selected region.
settings.api_key_help: Leave blank to bootstrap an anonymous site and receive a stable key automatically.
settings.registration_email_help: Optional for normal operation. Set this to your account email only when using the plugin Register Site flow; portal registration does not need it.
settings.preferred_endpoint_help: Populated automatically when bootstrap selects a regional endpoint.
settings.fail_open_label: Allow requests when Forum Fortress is unavailable
settings.fail_open_help: Recommended for normal operation so a network outage does not lock users out.
settings.block_reject_action_spam_clean: Spam-clean content and suspend its author

dashboard.tagline: Protection status, controls, and account links.
dashboard.maintenance_help: Less common account and diagnostic actions
dashboard.registration_help: Use Register Site only when attaching this forum to an account. Normal operation bootstraps automatically, and portal registration remains available.
dashboard.deprovision_help: Use this before removing the Composer package through Extension Manager. It removes this forum from Forum Fortress, clears local credentials, and pauses automatic bootstrap until the extension is re-enabled. Paid non-trial accounts are retained; accounts with other forums keep those forums.
dashboard.deprovision_confirm: Remove this forum from Forum Fortress? This cannot be undone. Other forums and paid non-trial accounts will be retained.
dashboard.deprovision_success: The Forum Fortress site was removed and automatic bootstrap is paused. Re-enable or reinstall the extension when you want to reconnect.
dashboard.deprovision_pending: Remote cleanup from a previous removal is still pending.
dashboard.request_timeout: The request timed out before Forum Fortress responded.
dashboard.request_failed: Forum Fortress could not complete the request. Check the connection and try again.
dashboard.portal_url_missing: Forum Fortress did not return a portal URL.
dashboard.portal_popup_blocked: The browser blocked the portal window. Allow popups for this site and try again.
dashboard.portal_success: Portal opened in a new tab.
